details:
Hello VRChat Team,

I am writing this as a transgender user who has spent a lot of time in VRChat and who genuinely wants the platform to succeed.

Every year during Pride Month, VRChat presents itself as supportive of LGBTQ+ people. There are Pride events, Pride banners, and public statements about inclusion. But from the perspective of many queer and trans users, there is a growing gap between those statements and what we experience every day.

In many public worlds, people openly mock pronouns. Some users replace pronouns with offensive political slogans or extremist references. Others deliberately harass transgender users, misgender them, or create an environment where queer people no longer feel welcome.

The problem is not that these people exist. The problem is that many LGBTQ+ users feel that moderation and safety measures are often too weak or too slow when these situations occur.

At the same time, VRChat promotes inclusion and diversity. If inclusion is important, then protecting vulnerable communities should be important as well.

Another issue is age verification and NSFW content. Instead of simply restricting or removing content, I believe a stronger age-verification system could allow adults to access adult content while automatically hiding it from users who are not verified. This could provide better protection for minors while giving adults more freedom.

I am concerned that if LGBTQ+ users continue feeling unsafe, ignored, or mocked, many of them will eventually leave. Communities are not lost overnight. They leave gradually when they no longer feel protected.

I am not writing this because I hate VRChat. I am writing this because I care about the platform and want it to become better.

Please listen to the experiences of transgender, queer, and other marginalized users. Pride Month should be more than a logo change or a celebration. It should also mean taking meaningful action when discrimination occurs.

Thank you for your time.
